zara: Quick question from today’s all-hands: can someone confirm the finalized release cadence?
phil: Final: minor releases every 3 weeks, major monthly.
maria: Are feature flags still mandatory for UX changes?
phil: Yes 02 all user-facing changes must be behind flags or rolled out as a canary for 24h.
sre-bot: Reminder: file a canary runbook in the release ticket and ping @sre 24h before start.
ops: Canary template recommended: 5% for 2h, 25% for 8h, hold 6h before full. Monitor p95/p99 + synthetics + error-rate.
customer-success: For Dedicated customers we need 48h heads-up and calendar alignment.
docs: I'll make a one-pager checklist (cadence, notif matrix, rollback triggers). Volunteers to review?
zara: Please tag sales & renewals when the blurb is ready. Thanks!
